```{=html}
<div id="of-config" data-base="configurator/">
  <noscript>The configurator needs JavaScript. All settings are listed on the <a href="settings.html">settings reference</a>.</noscript>
</div>
<script src="configurator/render.js"></script>
<script src="configurator/app.js"></script>
```

The preview is drawn in the browser by a port of the watch face's drawing code, using sample sensor data
(steps, heart rate, battery, …). Fonts are web stand-ins for Garmin's device fonts, so text differs slightly
from the watch; Quartz and dot-matrix fonts are drawn the same way as on the watch.
